text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's the Chairwoman♪ Is that what they 
call the highest evaluation?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm not merely repeating the report's 
conclusion. I had the chance to observe 
today's training as well!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"And this evaluation takes all that into 
account! Hold your head up high!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ With this, I'm sure we can deliver 
"love" to the whole wide world♡

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Love-chan has been working so, so 
hard, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"All that's left is to make full use of 
this environment and build the strongest 
team in the remaining time...!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Mm! I have high expectations of you!
